sections.content: We are seeking a Data Engineer to develop scalable data infrastructure and support data-driven decision-making. The successful candidate will work with cross-functional teams to design, implement, and maintain reliable data pipelines.

Develop and maintain scalable ETL and ELT data pipelines using Python and SQL. Design and optimize data transformation workflows using distributed processing frameworks such as Apache Spark. Build and maintain cloud-based data warehouses and data lakes. Implement automated CI/CD workflows for data engineering applications. Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver reliable analytical solutions.

Proficiency in Python and SQL for data manipulation and automation. Experience developing ETL or ELT pipelines. Familiarity with AWS cloud services and data warehousing technologies. Understanding of relational databases and data modelling principles. Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities.

Experience with Azure Databricks, Apache Spark, or PySpark. Familiarity with Docker, Terraform, and GitHub Actions. Knowledge of CI/CD principles and automated deployment workflows. Experience working with Delta Lake or similar lakehouse technologies.
